full_denominator.definition: Unwithdrawn github-reviewed GHSAs at HEAD, published>=2025-05-01, GitHub owner initial A-M, named repository, not in fp211/publication exclusion union.

routed_candidate_pool.definition: Denominator rows where the mechanical keyword router returned ROUTE. Routing only.

deep_reviewed_sample.definition: Non-exhaustive seven-gate sample. Not a coverage census of the denominator or of the routed pool.

unresolved_coverage.definition: Denominator minus deep-reviewed sample. UNREVIEWED, not REJECT. Absence of review is not negative proof.
